name: @corbits-builder/project
description: Settles with the person how Builder works on the whole project, such as whether it stops to ask for their approval.
author: Sawyer Cutler <sawyer@dirtroad.dev>

builder.when: The person wants Builder to go ahead without stopping to ask them, or to start asking them again.
builder.unless: They want a piece of work done or changed; that is the plugin for that work.

hand-over.when: The person says to just build it or to stop asking, or wants to be asked for their approval again.
hand-over.unless: They already answered this screen for what they asked, or they want only one document approved now.

examples: stop asking me and get on with it
ask me before each step again
